notes.title: Game Update 1.1.0 - Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]
We have a fresh batch of fixes so you can keep dashing and swinging smoothly. Hope you enjoy it!

[h2]Corrections and Enhancements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Camera Fix:[/b] The camera no longer shakes upon death, providing a smoother experience for the player. The camera now properly adjusts when the player exits the screen, ensuring a more seamless transition.
[*] [b]Visual Adjustments:[/b] Background color intensity in the stages has been fine-tuned to improve the overall aesthetic of the game.
[*] [b]Audio Fix:[/b] Sound effects volume has been adjusted, including the gravity modifier, for a more balanced auditory experience.
[*] [b]Gameplay Enhancement:[/b] Projectiles are now removed upon restarting the stage, preventing undesired situations.
[*] [b]Completion Indicators: [/b]Upon completing a stage, there are now clear indicators showing the world and stage the player has reached.
[*] [b]Visible Durability:[/b] Durability indicators have been added for breakable platforms, providing players with crucial information during gameplay.
[*] [b]Time Correction:[/b] Fixed timing issues in World 3, Secret 1, ensuring consistent gaming experience.
[/list]

[b]We appreciate your ongoing support and feedback! Enjoy playing the updated and improved version of Dash & Swing![/b]
